data.description:
Remove the refs that pin pre-rewrite history, and take a backup that lives outside the repo.
Without this the reclaim lands at **167 MB instead of ~94 MiB**. session_log **1cb6-d553-6565-49b4** (measured facts; do not re-derive).

## Why
Measured: remote tag `pre-heal-a118-20260710T005736Z` (`2a77dd48`) is an ancestor of
`origin/tickets` and pins **22,317 commits / 63,202,159 bytes** of `.bridge_state`. A full clone
fetches tags, so leaving it defeats most of the reclaim. It is absent from Gerrit and replication is
`mirror = false`, so deletion sticks and will not be recreated. Also delete the host-local
`pre-a3-remediation` tag (`0adbd40a`, ~64.8 MB reachable).

An **in-repo** archive branch or tag reclaims nothing — reachable objects are served and repacked
forever (crates.io's receipts: 1.73 GB live index vs **6.94 GB** archive repo). So the backup must
leave the repository: `git bundle create` from an **unfiltered** clone, stored off-repo, including the
tag tips being deleted.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `git ls-remote --heads --tags origin` (de-peeling `^{}` entries) is enumerated at run time and
      every ref whose ancestry intersects the old tip is listed. Do **not** hardcode a count — today
      it is 13 heads + 16 distinct tags. Tier: **repo-level script**.
- [ ] After deletion, **no ref a default clone fetches** has the old tip as an ancestor. Tier:
      `ls-remote` + `merge-base --is-ancestor` loop. (Scoped deliberately: origin also carries ~120
      `refs/pull/*` and ~2,671 `refs/changes/*`, but those descend from `main`'s root and a default
      clone fetches neither. `refs/reconciler/lock` is a **blob**, so it carries no ancestry.)
- [ ] The off-repo bundle exists, was created from an **unfiltered** clone, contains the old tip and
      both deleted tag tips, and `git bundle verify` passes. **[operator-attested]**
- [ ] Restoring the bundle into a scratch repo reproduces the old tip SHA exactly. Tier:
      **integration** in a throwaway clone.

## Files
`infra/scripts/` (hygiene + bundle helper), runbook notes

Scope: S. Depends on A6-0c (the bundle should be taken with the same unfiltered-clone helper).
